description: This file defines the LeaveDetailedModel class, which implements serialization of detailed leave data for the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It constructs a data array representing leave details, including dates, status, actions, balances, leave type, and last comment, for API responses.

classes.name: LeaveDetailedModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing detailed leave information into an API-friendly array structure, conforming to the Normalizable interface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a DetailedLeave object for serialization.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the DetailedLeave object into an associative array with structured leave data, formatted for API responses.
